NEWS: Tesla has officially overtaken Audi in global car sales for the first time ever.
Audi sold 1.67 million vehicles in 2024, down 12% YoY, whereas Tesla sold 1.79 million in 2024. Deliveries of Audi's fully electric models declined 8% globally to around 164,000 units.
